header.name: Fundamentals of Audio for Engineers
header.description:
In this course students learn the basic concepts of audio, acoustics and electronics, and how they can be applied to understand generation, processing, storing and distribution of audio signal. Topics include: sound waves, ear and hearing, musical sound, basic electronics,

The course will be beneficial for students planning for a career in media and entertainment Industry.

This course can be a pre-requisite course for Digital Audio - (Procedural Game Audio, Algorithmic Composition & Sound Synthesis)
prerequisites_mandatory: Basic knowledge of Class 12 Maths & Physics
prerequisites_desirable: Students should have access to laptops and headphones for each class
